title: Ferry
description: Ferry L7 load balancer: SLOs, RED per route and per backend, health, resilience and config. Metrics from the admin API's /metrics.

panels.title: Added latency p50
panels.description: SLO: under 0.2 ms. Latency Ferry itself adds: time to response headers minus time spent waiting on upstreams (ferry_request_overhead_seconds).

panels.title: Added latency p99
panels.description: SLO: under 1 ms at 10k req/s per core.

panels.title: Requests per core-second
panels.description: Throughput per CPU core actually used: request rate divided by CPU seconds per second. The latency SLO applies at 10k.

panels.title: Success ratio
panels.description: SLO: 99.95% of requests succeed (non-5xx) while backends are healthy. Compare with the healthy-endpoint panels below.

panels.title: Failed or cut-off requests (range)
panels.description: SLO: zero dropped requests during reloads and rolling restarts. 5xx answers plus responses not delivered in full, over the dashboard range. Read with the reload and restart counts beside it and the timeline below.

panels.title: Resident memory growth
panels.description: SLO: flat memory over a 72-hour soak. Slope of resident memory per hour over the last 6 hours, per process.

panels.title: Added latency (Ferry overhead)
panels.description: Quantiles of ferry_request_overhead_seconds. Dashed lines: 0.2 ms (p50 SLO) and 1 ms (p99 SLO).

panels.title: Reloads, restarts and failures
panels.description: Config reloads and proxy starts against 5xx answers and cut-off responses. A zero-drop rollout shows reload and start markers with flat failure lines.

targets.legendFormat: proxies started in the last minute

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: process_resident_memory_bytes per proxy. Flat over a soak is the SLO.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Downstream requests per second by route.

panels.title: Error ratio (5xx)
panels.description: Share of each route's requests answered 5xx.

panels.title: Request duration p99
panels.description: Arrival to last response byte, including backend time.

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: All routes.

panels.title: Local replies by reason
panels.description: Requests Ferry answered itself: no route, rate limited, no healthy upstream, overflow, upstream failure, timeout, ...

panels.title: gRPC status
panels.description: gRPC responses by grpc-status, from headers or trailers.

panels.title: Upstream rate by cluster
panels.description: Upstream attempts per second (retries included).

panels.title: Upstream 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of upstream responses that were 5xx, per cluster.

panels.title: Upstream latency p99
panels.description: Time from sending an attempt to its response headers.

panels.title: Endpoints
panels.description: Configured, healthy (active checks), ejected (outlier detection) and eligible endpoints per cluster.

panels.title: Ejections and panic mode
panels.description: Outlier ejections per minute; panic mode means too few endpoints are healthy and health is ignored.

panels.title: Upstream failures
panels.description: Connect failures, resets before response headers and per-try timeouts.

panels.title: Retries and retry budget
panels.description: Retries per second, policy retries refused by the budget, and the budget's remaining headroom.

panels.title: Circuit breakers
panels.description: Usage as a share of each limit, and requests refused because a breaker was full.

panels.title: Connections and load per endpoint
panels.description: Idle pooled connections and in-flight requests per endpoint.

panels.title: Downstream connections
panels.description: Open connections and new connections per second.

panels.title: Handshake and PROXY errors
panels.description: TLS handshakes that failed and connections dropped for a bad PROXY header.

panels.title: Config
panels.description: Snapshot version per proxy, seconds since the last successful load, and access-log lines dropped.
